basic_details.short_information: Maulana Azad National Institute of Technology Bhopal (MANIT) Recruitment 2026 notification has been released by Maulana Azad National Institute of Technology Bhopal (MANIT) on its official website for the recruitment of 2 Visiting Ophthalmologist and Part-time General Duty Medical Officer posts under Advertisement No. Rectt./Cont./Medical/2026/04. This recruitment offers an excellent opportunity for qualified medical professionals seeking contract-based positions through a walk-in interview.

rows.event: Walk-in-Interview for Part-time General Duty Medical Officer

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for MANIT Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to submit the application form via Google Form?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the application form through the Google Form is 29th July 2026. Ensure all required documents are uploaded correctly before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the eligibility criteria for the Visiting Ophthalmologist post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Visiting Ophthalmologist position, candidates must have an MBBS degree along with a Diploma in Ophthalmology or possess three years of post-M.D./Diploma experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Part-time General Duty Medical Officer?
faq.answer: The Part-time General Duty Medical Officer will receive a monthly salary ranging from ₹60,000/- to ₹65,000/-. This is a contract-based position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for these positions?
faq.answer: The age limit for both the Visiting Ophthalmologist and Part-time General Duty Medical Officer positions is not above 60 years as of the last date of application, which is 29th July 2026.

faq.question: Q5. How will the selection be made for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these positions will be based on the candidate's performance during the walk-in interview. Candidates are advised to prepare well for the interview.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the information available, there is no application fee mentioned for this recruitment drive. Candidates can attend the walk-in interview without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the Maulana Azad National Institute of Technology Bhopal (MANIT). Specific details about the venue and reporting time will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies announced?
faq.answer: MANIT Bhopal has announced a total of 2 vacancies for these positions. One vacancy is for the Visiting Ophthalmologist and the other is for the Part-time General Duty Medical Officer.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for both the Visiting Ophthalmologist and Part-time General Duty Medical Officer positions is contract-based. This means the employment will be for a fixed tenure.
